stories.title: PF diz ter conduzido 48 pessoas e apreendido R$ 769 mil por suspeita de crimes eleitorais

en.title: Federal Police say they have conducted 48 people and seized R$ 769 thousand on suspicion of electoral crimes
en.summary: Brazil's Federal Police reported conducting 48 people for suspected involvement in electoral crimes during the first round of elections and seized approximately R$ 769 thousand in assets.

stories.title: Muito antes da Times Square, EUA influenciam urbanismo de São Paulo há quase um século

en.title: Long before Times Square, the United States has influenced São Paulo's urbanism for almost a century
en.summary: A proposed Times Square-style project in São Paulo remains uncertain following another legal denial. The initiative reflects a broader history of São Paulo's urban development influenced by American models.

stories.title: Lula diz que pesquisa que vale é a urna, e Flávio afirma estar confiante em vitória no 1º turno

en.title: Lula says the poll that matters is the ballot box, and Flávio claims confidence in first round victory
en.summary: The two leading presidential candidates exchanged criticism while voting on Sunday. President Lula expressed confidence in victory, while Senator Flávio Bolsonaro stated that party internal polls indicate voter transfers in his favor.

stories.title: Decisão de Nunes Marques recoloca Deltan na disputa pelo Senado no PR

en.title: Nunes Marques' decision puts Deltan back in the Senate race in Paraná
en.summary: The president of Brazil's Supreme Electoral Court overturned an individual decision that had denied the candidacy registration of former prosecutor Deltan Dalagnol for the Paraná Senate seat.

stories.title: Polícia Federal prende 28 pessoas por crimes eleitorais neste domingo

en.title: Federal Police arrest 28 people for electoral crimes on Sunday
en.summary: Brazilian Federal Police detained 28 individuals across seven states and the Federal District for electoral crimes including irregular campaign advertising and vote buying. Authorities seized approximately 57,379 reais in assets and cash.

stories.title: Flávio e Lula votam no 1º turno; acompanhe voto dos demais candidatos

en.title: Flávio and Lula vote in first round; follow votes of other candidates
en.summary: Candidate Flávio Bolsonaro voted Sunday morning at a school in Rio de Janeiro's Vila Isabel neighborhood, accompanied by his wife and other party candidates and family members.

stories.title: PF conduz 28 pessoas e apreende R$ 57 mil por suspeita de crimes eleitorais neste domingo

en.title: PF conducts 28 people and seizes 57 thousand reais on suspicion of electoral crimes on Sunday
en.summary: Federal Police conducted 28 individuals and seized 57,000 reais in connection with suspected electoral crimes on Sunday.

stories.title: Governo do Iêmen anuncia ofensiva militar para retomar territórios sob controle dos houthis

en.title: Yemen government announces military offensive to retake territories under Houthi control
en.summary: The Saudi-backed Yemeni government announced a major military operation against Iran-backed Houthi rebels with the goal of reclaiming territory under their control.

stories.title: Nunes Marques suspende decisão que indeferiu candidatura de Deltan Dallagnol

en.title: Nunes Marques suspends decision that rejected Deltan Dallagnol's candidacy
en.summary: A judge suspended a previous decision that had rejected Deltan Dallagnol's candidacy.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro vota no Rio e aposta em mudança de votos para vencer no primeiro turno

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro votes in Rio and bets on vote shifts to win in first round
en.summary: Flávio Bolsonaro voted in Rio de Janeiro and expressed confidence in receiving transferred votes from other candidates to win in the first round.

stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz confiar em 'voto de revolta' no primeiro turno

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro says he trusts in 'protest vote' in first round
en.summary: After voting in Rio de Janeiro, presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro stated that internal party polls indicate vote transfers to his campaign.

stories.title: Todo mundo vota hoje; TSE não separou dias para eleitores de Flávio e Lula

en.title: Everyone votes today; TSE did not separate voting days for Flávio and Lula voters
en.summary: A false audio circulating on WhatsApp claims the electoral court scheduled different voting dates for supporters of Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula, which is untrue.

stories.title: Fachin defende ‘soberania popular’ e que todo cidadão exerça seu direito ao voto

en.title: Fachin defends 'popular sovereignty' and that every citizen exercise their right to vote
en.summary: The president of Brazil's Supreme Court stated that voting day represents the exercise of popular sovereignty and democratic freedom. He emphasized the importance of all citizens exercising their voting rights and praised the electoral system.

stories.title: Estado do Rio registra 127 substituições de urnas em 4 horas de votação

en.title: Rio State registers 127 ballot box replacements in 4 hours of voting
en.summary: The Rio de Janeiro Electoral Court maintained teams on standby to replace electronic voting machines that malfunctioned during voting. The tribunal monitored replacement numbers throughout the day and distributed technicians across the state.

stories.title: ‘Fizemos tudo o que pudemos’, diz Raquel Lyra após votar em em PE

en.title: 'We did everything we could', says Raquel Lyra after voting in PE
en.summary: The governor of Pernambuco voted in her stronghold and stated she had done everything within her reach. She is competing against a rival in one of the country's most unpredictable state elections.

stories.title: Brasileiros vão às urnas nos EUA sob temor do ICE, e abstenção deve aumentar

en.title: Brazilians go to the polls in the USA amid ICE fears, and abstention is expected to increase
en.summary: Approximately 265,000 Brazilians eligible to vote in the United States represent a 45% increase from 2022. The majority of these voters are women with higher education, though concerns about enforcement may affect turnout.

stories.title: Quanto é a multa para quem não votar?

en.title: What is the fine for not voting?
en.summary: Voters in Brazil who fail to cast ballots on Sunday must justify their absence or pay a fine of 3.51 reais. The fine can be settled through multiple methods including the electoral court's online system, a mobile app, or in person at an electoral notary office.
